source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 575 removes rss.message.loadWebPageOnSelect and its delayed external-browser call from shouldShowSummary. Explicit opening remains governed by rss.show.content-base and the chosen destination. Source callers should not restore an extra webpage open as a side effect of simple row selection. Current source retains the explicit open-mode preference and browser destination path. No RSS selection or external browser test was run.
title: Keep selecting an RSS message separate from opening its webpage
